sectionHeader.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sectionHeader.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about appointments, insurance coverage, and visiting CareFirst Clinic.

items.question: Do you accept health insurance?
items.answer: Yes, we partner with major international and local health insurance providers. Our billing specialists handle direct claims processing to minimize your out-of-pocket expenses.

items.question: How do I schedule a same-day consultation?
items.answer: You can reserve a same-day appointment through our 24/7 online booking portal or by contacting our patient care coordinators directly. Urgent appointments are prioritized based on clinical need.

items.question: What documents should I bring to my first appointment?
items.answer: Please bring a valid photo ID, your active insurance card, recent lab or imaging results, and a list of any current medications or supplements you take regularly.

items.question: How quickly will I receive my diagnostic test results?
items.answer: Standard blood tests and digital imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) reports are typically processed within 24 to 48 hours and made securely accessible in your CareFirst digital patient portal.

items.question: Can I consult with specialists remotely via telehealth?
items.answer: Yes, CareFirst offers secure HIPAA-compliant video consultations for routine follow-ups, medication reviews, and second medical opinions.
